messages:
Olivia Grant: hi! accepted the org invite but I only see public repos. trying to access eng-models/core and get a 404. also when enabling 2FA GitHub suggested a passkey but my phone says 'platform not supported'. who do I ping?

onboarding-bot: welcome to Redwood! :tada: Common causes: invite sent to another email, outside collaborator role, or SSO/2FA not completed. See onboarding doc: https://docs.redwood.example/devex/github-access. @Marcus can triage org side.

Marcus: @Olivia Grant what's your GitHub handle?

Olivia Grant: oliviagrant

Marcus: got it. seeing you as a member but "sso_required": true. Try visiting https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso and click Authorize. If you don't see the banner, I can re-trigger from the IdP.

Olivia Grant: I opened the org SSO page and it asked me to authorize, but during the flow GitHub asked to enroll passkey and my Pixel 2 failed with "platform not supported". I canceled and got a YubiKey enrollment prompt later which also failed.

IT-Priya: Pixel 2 is old and the platform passkey flow can be flaky. Options: 1) enroll TOTP (Authy/Google Authenticator) as primary, 2) request a hardware security key from IT (file ticket RW-922), or 3) register a managed device. For now enroll TOTP to unblock SSO.

Olivia Grant: enrolled TOTP and completed SSO. Marcus, can you confirm perms?

Marcus: I see you in team eng-models-readers only. I just added you to eng-models-dev (write) and granted repo access to eng-models/core. It may take ~60s to prop.

Rebecca: FYI eng-models/core has branch protection on main and codeowners, so pushes to main are blocked. Create a branch and open a PR.

Olivia Grant: still seeing 404 for the repo URL in browser but `gh api /orgs/redwood-inference/memberships/oliviagrant` shows "sso_required": false and "role": "member".

DevEx-Kyle: 404 after SSO often means cached credentials. Steps: 1) logout of github.com, 2) clear cookies or use incognito, 3) re-login and refresh the repo page. If using CLI, run `gh auth refresh` or clear credential helper.

Olivia Grant: did incognito + re-login, can access the repo now and cloned successfully. push worked after I updated remote to use https with gh auth.

IT-Priya: Logged RW-922 for hardware key request and noted Pixel-2 passkey issue in the onboarding checklist.

Olivia Grant: thanks everyone! quick Q: where's the onboarding doc that lists default team memberships?

Marcus: https://docs.redwood.example/people/onboarding. It lists default teams per role; reach out if something looks off. Welcome aboard :wave:

Olivia Grant: awesome, thanks y'all :heart:
